Online Quran classes in the UK, wherever you live

Lessons are live and online, so you can learn Quran online in the UK from any town or city. Families searching for online Quran classes in London, a Quran teacher in London, Quran classes in Birmingham or a Quran teacher in Manchester do not need to travel to a centre: share your city and preferred UK local time, and the coordinator confirms which teacher is available.

Online Quran classes for adults in the UK can be planned around work and family commitments. Tell the coordinator whether you are a beginner, returning after a break or improving your recitation, and which times you can keep each week.
